title: [DATA-2685] Sort events by their Govern product tag and split shared features by profile
body:
Ticket: [DATA-2685](https://app.clickup.com/t/17tnw2b8r0k)

## What changed

New product features kept landing in family `other` because the prefix list in `amplitude_event_family` didn't know them, so they dropped out of every Win and Serve activity view. Opponent research, Campaign Story, Priorities and Chief of Staff were all caught this way. Engineers already tag each event `product:win|serve|shared` in Amplitude Govern, and those tags reach the warehouse. This PR reads them.

- **`int__amplitude_event_catalog`**: the Govern `product:` tag places only events the name rules leave in `other`, giving the new families `win_declared` and `shared`, or `serve`. An event the name rules already place never moves, even when its tag disagrees; that case sets `product_label_conflict` instead. New columns: `name_rule_family`, `govern_product`, `govern_surface`, `product_area`, `is_shared`, `product_label_conflict`. Out-of-set tag values and duplicate `product:` tags read as untagged.
- **New view `int__amplitude_events_classified`**: every event with its resolved `event_product` and `product_source`. Shared features are split per event, in this order:
  1. the event's explicit `product` property;
  2. `activeProduct`, which the web app will attach in a follow-up omni PR;
  3. the user's only product;
  4. otherwise `win` (`assumed_win`), for logged-in users with both products or neither.

  Anonymous shared events get no product.
- **Repointed at that view**: `int__user_activity_monthly` (the `active_months` CTE only), `int__user_product_area_activity_monthly`, `int__user_product_activity`, `int__user_win_activity_weekly`, and the `amplitude_events` mart. In these, `is_win`/`is_serve` now mean `event_product = 'win'`/`'serve'`, and `family` can now be `win_declared` or `shared`.
- **New mart `amplitude_unsorted_events`**: logged-in, non-staff events still in `other`, one row per day, event and user. It feeds a "Not yet sorted" count on the journey dashboard.
- **New warn-only test `assert_tag_sorted_share_stable`**: flags a jump of more than 10 points, month over month, in the share of Win or Serve active users that comes from tag-sorted or shared events.
- Docs updated: the macro header, the yaml descriptions, and the win/serve analytics knowledge references. The `analytics/lib` membership helpers are unchanged, with a comment noting they don't yet see shared-feature events.

## Why it is shaped this way

- **The tag only fills gaps.** It never moves an event the name rules already place, so nothing that counts today stops counting.
- **Governed metrics are out of scope by design.** No `sem_*.yml` and no activation or recurrence macro changed. Compiled SQL for every model calling `is_outreach_activation_event`, `is_serve_activation_event`, `amplitude_event_is_recurrent`, `product_output_predicate` or `is_product_output*` is byte-identical to `main`.
- **Shared events resolve per event, not per event name.** The same feature is used from both profiles.

## Verification

### Dev build, 2026-10-23 (`private_tristan`), not production

Baseline is prod `int__user_activity_monthly`, captured 2026-10-22, staff excluded. Recomputing the old rule on the dev view reproduces the baseline exactly.

| Month | Win users base → dev | Win days base → dev | Serve users base → dev |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2025-04 to 2026-06 | identical | identical | identical |
| 2026-07 | 1,336 → 1,336 | 2,758 → 2,764 | 90 → 90 |
| 2026-08 | 1,951 → 1,955 | 3,991 → 4,028 | 69 → 69 |
| 2026-09 | 1,442 → 1,444 | 3,792 → 3,833 | 71 → 71 |
| 2026-10 (partial) | 1,370 → 1,373 | 4,121 → 4,147 | 61 → 61 |

- **Active-user change is small.** The biggest move is Win users +0.2% (Aug). Users of the newly sorted features were nearly all already Win-active that month. The gain is per-feature visibility in the product-area views: `int__user_product_area_activity_monthly` goes from 115,622 to 117,532 rows. New areas include opponent research (1,104 user-months) and Campaign Story (399).
- **Shared features:** AI Chat is 194 Win / 20 Serve events, Dictation is all Win (483), and Chief of Staff is 214 Win / 29 Serve.
- **`assumed_win`** covers at most 5 logged-in users a month.
- **Not yet sorted:** 343 non-staff logged-in users in the last 30 days, across 30 event types.
- **Tests:** the unit tests on the catalog and the new view pass. The build of the changed models, singular tests and descendants passes, apart from 3 errors traced to the dev environment, not this change:
  - `user_journey_refresh_log` has no permission on `airbyte_source_finance`.
  - Two tests read stale dev `users` / `int__user_revenue_profile` tables. They return 0 rows on prod.
- **Caveat:** the dev `users` table is stale, so in dev, shared events from the newest users fall to `assumed_win` instead of `user_product`. Prod will be slightly more precise.

## Operational notes

- **Column order shifts.** In `amplitude_events`, `product_area` and `product_source` now sit before `family`, `is_win` and `is_serve`. In the `amplitude_event_catalog` mart, `family` moves from 2nd to 5th. Sigma reads columns by name, so nothing should break, but positional readers would.
- **Cost.** The `amplitude_events` mart view now joins the catalog and `users` on each query. Both are small. Watch Sigma latency.
- **Downstream readers.** omni's weekly governance scripts read `family` and `is_win` from the catalog. They handle `win_declared` (the `startswith('win')` check) and display the new values without breaking.
- **Expected warning.** The Serve share in the warn test rests on about 80 users and may warn next month on small numbers.

> **Medium Risk**
> Changes how Win/Serve MAU and product-area metrics are computed (small user-count drift, new tag/profile resolution) across core journey models and the Sigma `amplitude_events` mart, while governed OKR activation macros are intentionally unchanged.
> 
> **Overview**
> Amplitude event taxonomy now **reads Govern `product:` / `surface:` tags only for events name rules leave in `other`**, adding catalog families `win_declared`, `shared`, and `serve` from tags without moving events the macro already classifies. **`int__amplitude_events_classified`** resolves per-event **`event_product`** and **`product_source`**, splitting **`product:shared`** features (Dictation, Contacts, etc.) across Win vs Serve via `product` / `activeProduct` / single-product users / logged-in **`assumed_win`**.
> 
> **Journey and BI layers** (`int__user_activity_monthly`, product-area and product-activity models, `int__user_win_activity_weekly`, **`amplitude_events`**) now count Win/Serve activity from **`event_product`**, not catalog `is_win`/`is_serve` alone. **`amplitude_unsorted_events`** surfaces still-unlabeled logged-in events; tests enforce tag gap-fill-only and warn on month-over-month shifts in tag-sorted active-user share.
> 
> Win/Serve analytics docs and notebook helper comments note that catalog-based predicates still omit shared-feature attribution until they join the classified view.

+{{ config(materialized="view") }}
+
+/*
+    One row per Amplitude event with the product it was used from.
+
+    Shared features (Dictation, Contacts and the like) have no product of
+    their own, so they take the profile they were used from: an explicit
+    `product` property, then `activeProduct`, then the user's only product.
+    A logged-in user with both products or neither is assumed Win, because
+    Serve users are few (Tristan's ruling of 2026-10-22). An event with no
+    numeric user id and no explicit property is anonymous marketing-site
+    traffic, not product use, so it carries no product. Property values other
+    than win and serve are skipped.
+*/
+with
+    events as (select * from {{ ref("stg_airbyte_source__amplitude_api_events") }}),
+
+    catalog as (select * from {{ ref("int__amplitude_event_catalog") }}),
+
+    users as (select user_id, is_win_user, is_serve_user from {{ ref("users") }}),
+
+    joined as (
+        select
+            e.*,
+            c.family,
+            c.product_area,
+            c.is_machine_emitted,
+            c.is_recurrent,
+            c.is_win,
+            c.is_serve,
+            c.is_shared,
+            c.name_rule_family,
+            case
+                when lower(e.event_properties:product::string) in ('win', 'serve')
+                then lower(e.event_properties:product::string)
+            end as property_product,
+            case
+                when lower(e.event_properties:activeproduct::string) in ('win', 'serve')
+                then lower(e.event_properties:activeproduct::string)
+            end as active_product,
+            case
+                when u.is_serve_user and not u.is_win_user
+                then 'serve'
+                when u.is_win_user and not u.is_serve_user
+                then 'win'
+            end as user_product
+        from events as e
+        left join catalog as c on c.event_type = e.event_type
+        left join users as u on u.user_id = try_cast(e.user_id as bigint)
+    )
+
+select
+    * except (
+        is_win,
+        is_serve,
+        is_shared,
+        name_rule_family,
+        property_product,
+        active_product,
+        user_product
+    ),
+    case
+        when is_shared

+            coalesce(
+                property_product,
+                active_product,
+                user_product,
+                case when try_cast(user_id as bigint) is not null then 'win' end
+            )
+        when is_win
+        then 'win'
+        when is_serve
+        then 'serve'
+    end as event_product,
+    case
+        when is_shared
+        then
+            case
+                when property_product is not null
+                then 'event_property'
+                when active_product is not null
+                then 'active_profile'
+                when user_product is not null
+                then 'user_product'
+                when try_cast(user_id as bigint) is not null
+                then 'assumed_win'
+            end
+        when is_win or is_serve
+        then
+            case when name_rule_family = 'other' then 'govern_tag' else 'event_name' end
+    end as product_source
+from joined

@@ -0,0 +1,62 @@
+{{ config(severity="warn") }}
+
+-- A tag edit in Govern can move users between "active" and "not" overnight.
+-- Warns when the share of a product's active users who rely on a tag or
+-- profile (any event not sorted by name) moves more than 0.10 month to month.
+-- Counts distinct logged-in users with a non-machine event in the month, minus
+-- staff and test accounts (the person-keyed int__civics_internal_persons set).
+with
+    internal_users as (
+        select k.user_id
+        from {{ ref("int__user_resolved_keys") }} as k
+        inner join
+            {{ ref("int__civics_internal_persons") }} as i
+            on i.gp_person_id = k.gp_person_id
+    ),
+
+    months as (
+        select
+            add_months(trunc(current_date(), 'MM'), -2) as prior_month,
+            add_months(trunc(current_date(), 'MM'), -1) as latest_month
+    ),
+
+    shares as (
+        select
+            e.event_product,
+            trunc(e.event_time, 'MM') as activity_month,
+            count(distinct try_cast(e.user_id as bigint)) as active_users,
+            count(
+                distinct case
+                    when e.product_source != 'event_name'
+                    then try_cast(e.user_id as bigint)
+                end
+            ) as tag_sorted_users
+        from {{ ref("int__amplitude_events_classified") }} as e
+        cross join months as m
+        left anti join internal_users as i on i.user_id = try_cast(e.user_id as bigint)
+        where
+            e.event_product in ('win', 'serve')
+            and try_cast(e.user_id as bigint) is not null
+            and not e.is_machine_emitted
+            and e.event_time >= '{{ var("product_telemetry_start") }}'
+            and trunc(e.event_time, 'MM') in (m.prior_month, m.latest_month)
+        group by 1, 2
+    )
+
+select
+    latest.event_product,
+    prior.tag_sorted_users / prior.active_users as prior_share,
+    latest.tag_sorted_users / latest.active_users as latest_share
+from shares as latest
+cross join months as m
+join
+    shares as prior
+    on prior.event_product = latest.event_product
+    and prior.activity_month = m.prior_month
+where
+    latest.activity_month = m.latest_month
+    and abs(
+        latest.tag_sorted_users / latest.active_users
+        - prior.tag_sorted_users / prior.active_users
+    )
+    > 0.10
